chromium_flags.description: List of Chromium command-line flags. Used to enforce security hardening, disable risky features, and enable enterprise controls. Flags are passed directly to the Chromium binary on launch.

enable_spellcheck.description: If true, enables spell-checking support by setting SPELLCHECK=1.

enable_webrtc_mute_capture.description: If true, sets WEBRTC_MUTE_CAPTURE=1 to mute camera/microphone by default, improving privacy.

enable_sandbox_debugging.description: If true, enables sandbox debugging via SANDBOX_DEBUG=1. Only use for diagnostics — never in production.

enable_sandbox.description: If false, sets NO_SANDBOX=1 to disable Chromium’s sandbox (e.g., for containerized or CI environments where sandboxing is unavailable).

disable_gpu.description: If true, sets DISABLE_GPU=1 to disable GPU acceleration — helpful for headless deployments or systems with problematic drivers.

disable_speech_recognition.description: If true, sets DISABLE_SPEECH_RECOGNITION=1 to disable web speech APIs, reducing attack surface and enhancing privacy.

extra_env.description: Key-value pairs for additional environment variables. Use sparingly; prefer explicitly defined options above for better control and documentation.
